title: Sr. Architect
description:
**Senior Architect – Job Responsibilities Key Skills**

* Lead and manage architectural design projects from concept through completion.
* Develop design concepts, presentations, drawings, specifications, and construction documentation.
* Coordinate with clients to understand project requirements, budgets, timelines, and design expectations.
* Manage and mentor junior architects and design team members.
* Coordinate with structural, MEP, civil, landscape, and other consultants.
* Review architectural drawings and ensure accuracy, quality, and compliance with project requirements.
* Ensure designs comply with local building codes, regulations, and applicable standards.
* Prepare and review BOQs, specifications, material selections, and tender documentation.
* Conduct site visits and monitor construction progress against approved drawings and specifications.
* Resolve design and technical issues during construction.
* Coordinate with contractors, vendors, consultants, and project management teams.
* Participate in client meetings, design reviews, presentations, and project discussions.
* Manage project schedules, deliverables, and design milestones.
* Review shop drawings, material submittals, mock\-ups, and samples.
* Support cost optimization and value\-engineering exercises while maintaining design intent.
* Identify project risks and coordinate timely resolution of issues.
* Maintain project documentation and ensure proper revision control.
* Stay updated on architectural trends, materials, technologies, sustainability practices, and relevant regulations.
* Ensure projects meet required standards for quality, functionality, aesthetics, and sustainability.
* Strong architectural design and technical knowledge
* AutoCAD, Revit/BIM, SketchUp, and other relevant design software
* Project and team management
* Client and consultant coordination
* Knowledge of building codes and construction practices
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making
* Knowledge of materials, specifications, and construction detailing

Pay: From ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: UX Engineer - Figma

The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience
* 4\+ years of UX, Product Design, or Interaction Design experience
* Experience designing enterprise SaaS applications or complex business systems
* Experience creating implementation\-ready wireframes, prototypes, specifications, and workflows

We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Senior SW Engineer (JAVA)
description:
Overview:

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Job Title:** Senior Software Engineer  

**Experience Level**: 5\-8 years of professional experience in the applicable field.  

**Education**: Requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Job Summary:**  

The Senior Software Engineer is a fully competent professional responsible for delivering complex software solutions by applying broad and deep knowledge of engineering principles, practices, and procedures. This role involves significant technical ownership, with assignments that demand originality, ingenuity, and the ability to make independent decisions that influence the organization’s projects or clients. The Senior Software Engineer cooperates with Architects to identify reference patterns and best practices and mentors and guides junior or intermediate engineers, providing technical direction and oversight when needed.  

The candidate, being in contact with other engineering teams in Europe, India and US, will work to the creation of a microservices architecture built in Java, Spring, React deployed in a container\-based environment (Kubernetes) into a cloud infrastructure
Principal Responsibilities:
* Design, develop, test, and implement complex software systems and applications, ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
* Apply broad technical expertise to solve advanced problems and deliver innovative solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural planning sessions.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to Associate, Junior, and Intermediate Software Engineers.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (e.g., product managers, QA, DevOps) to define and implement requirements.
* Take ownership of projects, ensuring completion within scope, timeline, and quality standards.
* Identify areas for process improvement and recommend enhancements that may have significant business impact.
* Research and evaluate new technologies, tools, or frameworks to improve the development process.
* Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for specific systems, components, or business areas.
* Provide recommendations that influence client deliverables or organizational decisions.


Position Requirements:
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related discipline (Master’s degree a plus).
* 5\-8 years of professional experience in software engineering or application development.
* Proven experience in Java programming especially with Spring framework (Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Data, etc.)
* String experience with API development (REST or GraphQL) and integration projects, with focus on security and performances.
* Proficiency with ORM frameworks and relational databases best practices
* Knowledge of JavaScript frontend frameworks (especially React) is preferred.
* Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and system scalability.
* Experience in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with secure coding practices and performance optimization.
* Experience in leveraging AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) and apply prompt engineering to accelerate delivery across development, testing, and operations.
* Able to design and build integrations with LLM services and cloud AI platforms, collaborating with Architects and Product teams to embed AI capabilities and agentic workflows into products.
* Good command of English (written and spoken)

**Skills and Competencies:*** Exceptional problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills with a high level of technical innovation.
* Strong ability to independently evaluate and make technical decisions with minimal supervision.
* Good communication and leadership skills for collaborating with stakeholders and guiding junior engineers.
* Proactive approach to identifying risks, proposing solutions, and driving technical strategy.
* Ability to manage broad, challenging assignments with originality and ingenuity.

 **Work Environment:*** Operates as a senior\-level individual contributor with minimal lead\-level or middle management intervention.
* Provides oversight and guidance to Associates or Intermediate Engineers.
* Has appreciable latitude for independent action and decision\-making on critical tasks.
* Contributes to strategic technical recommendations that impact business outcomes.

 **What We Offer:**  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M:**  

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.  

* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit** – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* **Accountability** – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* **Metrics\-Driven Results** – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.
  

**EEO:**
  

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Cslt-Prog & Proj Mgmt
description:
### **When you join Verizon**


You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.

### **What you’ll be doing...**


We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Lead SAM Flexera Expert to play a crucial "player\-coach" role within our Software Asset Management (SAM) function. You will architect the end\-to\-end publisher management strategy while actively working as a hands\-on implementor for our most complex, tier\-1 software publishers within the Flexera One platform. In this role, you will drive enterprise\-wide continuous cost optimization programs, manually design and configure complex licensing frameworks, serve as the lead technical defender during major vendor audits, and mentor a team of SAM professionals.


Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Defining the end\-to\-end lifecycle strategy for software publishers within Flexera, while rolling up your sleeves to directly execute the onboarding, configuration, and compliance monitoring for critical tier\-1 vendors.
* Acting as the primary authority and hands\-on implementor for translating highly complex EULAs, MSAs, and amendments into accurate license records and product use rights (PUR) within the platform.
* Directing and executing continuous cost optimization initiatives, actively diving into the data to identify strategic opportunities regarding shelfware, hybrid cloud licensing, and enterprise\-wide application rationalization.
* Leading the defense and data strategy during major software vendor audits, collaborating closely with IT Procurement, Legal, and Sourcing teams to mitigate financial risk.
* Executing advanced data normalization, beacon management, and hands\-on troubleshooting of the Flexera architecture to ensure optimal platform health.
* Overseeing the strategic roadmap and technically supporting the implementation of Flexera integrations with enterprise systems like ServiceNow CMDB, cloud portals (AWS/Azure/GCP), and discovery tools.
* Mentoring and guiding SAM analysts by leading by example, fostering a culture of continuous ITAM process improvement and technical excellence.
* Developing and presenting executive\-level reporting on software compliance risk, ELP status, and realized cost savings.
* Collaborating with Sourcing and Legal teams to maintain continuously updated compliance workpapers, defend against vendor audits, and proactively support contract renewals.

### **What we’re looking for...**


You are a strategic leader and hands\-on technical expert with an authoritative understanding of software asset management and complex publisher licensing frameworks. You possess excellent problem\-solving skills, a proven ability to execute complex platform configurations, and a passion for mentoring others. You thrive when balancing high\-stakes compliance strategy with the technical implementation required to realize multi\-million\-dollar cost\-saving opportunities.

### **You’ll need to have:**

* 9\+ years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM) or IT Asset Management (ITAM), with at least 5\+ years of dedicated, hands\-on implementation and architecture experience in Flexera.
* Proven leadership experience blending end\-to\-end publisher lifecycle strategy with direct, hands\-on platform execution.
* Expert\-level understanding of software licensing frameworks for major vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe, SAP, Red Hat, VMware/Broadcom).
* Extensive technical experience managing ecosystem integrations and databases, including ServiceNow CMDB, SQL queries, REST APIs, and discovery agent operations.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex licensing data into actionable business strategies for leadership.

### **Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Flexera Certified Professional / Administrator (Flexera One / FNMS) and/or CSAM (Certified Software Asset Manager) or IAITAM certification.
* Scripting and automation skills (such as Python or PowerShell) to streamline API integrations and automate data management tasks.
* Understanding of how SAM intersects with Cybersecurity, specifically regarding the identification and management of End\-of\-Life (EOL) or End\-of\-Support (EOS) software to mitigate security risks.


If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

### **Where you’ll be working**


In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours**


40### **Equal Employment Opportunity**


Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: EPM Solution Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  

SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company. We operate a network of over **2,500 laboratories and business facilities across 115 countries**, supported **by a team of over 100,000 dedicated professionals**. With **more than 145 years of service excellence**, we combine the precision and accuracy that define Swiss companies to help organizations achieve t**he highest standards of quality, compliance and sustainability.**


Our brand promise – **“when you need to be sure”** – underscores our commitment to **trust, integrity and reliability**, enabling businesses to **thrive with confidence**. We proudly deliver our **expert services** through the **SGS name** and a portfolio of **trusted specialized brands**, including **Applied Technical Services**, **Brightsight**, **Bluesign** and **Nutrasource**.

 **Job Description**  

As an **EPM Solution Engineer**, you will act as a key technical expert for SGS's Hyperion, Essbase and related EPM applications, driving their development, stability and continuous improvement. You will ensure solutions follow industry best practices for coding, architecture, security and performance while applying your expertise across the software development lifecycle.


You will play an active role in development and enhancement initiatives, ensuring business requirements are understood, challenged where necessary, and translated into scalable, sustainable solutions. You will assess the impact of new requirements and provide technical guidance that balances business needs with long\-term system integrity and maintainability.


You will oversee the maintenance and support of EPM applications, including metadata management, calculation scripts, business rules, reports and dashboards. Working closely with business stakeholders, IT teams and service providers, you will manage requests, support incident resolution and contribute to strategic initiatives such as platform upgrades, ERP transformation projects and the evolution of Oracle EPM solutions.

**Responsibilities**

* Oversee that the software development activity is carried out in accordance with SGS and market standards.
* Executes the validation of the technical designs \& oversees the application development activity and ensures that deliverables follow the defined \& market coding, architecture and security rules and guidelines.
* Ensuring that development estimates made by partners are reasonable and acceptable.
* Ensure that the development activities in the field of applications development and projects comply with the SGS technical standards and quality.
* Monitor 2nd or 3rd Level Support, working closely with AM Teams, business users, infrastructure team and application outsourcer (Oracle).
* Attend internal and external service meetings to discuss issues and improvement plans.
* Manage and monitor issues closely and ensure their resolution according to applicable escalation procedures.
* Perform regular service quality checks on incident tickets and requests and prepare improvement plans.
* Maintain the access and security configurations, ensuring the right level of control in line with the standards required by system auditors and internal controls.
* Monitor monthly maintenance activities: Maintain metadata, member list, FX Rates, business rules and validation checks.
* Support the year end Rollover activities, and support any other activity related financial closing.
* Oversee technical architecture activities such as patching, backups or application copies, working closely with DBA and infrastructure teams.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure teams, Solution Architects, Delivery managers and Application Outsourcers for any initiative that will require SGS engagement.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* **Minimum 5 years’ experience in Hyperion or related EPM products** on any of the following processes:
	+ Financial Planning and Budgeting.
	+ Enterprise Data Management \& **Essbase**.
	+ Financial Consolidation and Closing.
	+ EPM Technical Architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with EPM development, including business rules, calculation scripts, metadata management and reporting.
* Experience supporting, enhancing and maintaining enterprise EPM applications.
* **Oracle EPM Cloud experience** is highly desirable.
* Experience with EPM upgrades, migrations or transformation initiatives is desirable.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management (ITIL) principles.
* Ability to assess the impact of business requirements and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills**

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance business requirements with long\-term system stability and architectural best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to influence decisions and provide trusted technical guidance.
* Collaborative, adaptable and comfortable working across global teams and external partners.
* Proactive, flexible and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Embraces change and continuous improvement.

  

**Additional Information** **Why SGS?**

* Join a globally recognized and stable company, a leader in the Testing, Inspection, and Certification (TIC) industry.
* Enjoy a **flexible schedule and a hybrid work model.**
* Access continuous learning opportunities through SGS University and Campus.
* Collaborate in a multinational environment with colleagues from various continents.

**Apply Now**:  

At SGS, we are committed to fostering an open, friendly, and supportive culture that thrives on teamwork. We value diversity and provide endless opportunities to learn, grow your expertise, and fulfill your potential. Apply now to join our motivated and dynamic team!

title: SB-1507 - Tech Delivery Lead
description:
**elivery Lead** **ROLE SUMMARY**
We are looking for an experienced Delivery Lead to drive end\-to\-end delivery for one or more projects within the Pickles Engineering Team. The ideal candidate should bring 10–15 years of overall experience, with proven ownership of at least one complex project involving multiple resources across engineering, QA, product, and stakeholder groups, specifically in Node.js, React, and Next.js based application delivery.  

This role requires strong delivery ownership, planning discipline, stakeholder communication, risk management, and the ability to lead distributed teams delivering modern JavaScript and TypeScript applications. The Delivery Lead will be accountable for project execution, team coordination, progress tracking, dependency management, and ensuring predictable, high\-quality delivery across Node.js back\-end services, React front\-end applications, and Next.js web platforms. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Delivery Ownership*** Own delivery planning and execution for one or more projects, ensuring scope, timelines, quality, and stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.
* Lead a team of multiple resources across development, QA, and support functions, ensuring clear work allocation, accountability, and progress visibility.
* Drive project ceremonies including sprint planning, stand\-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and dependency discussions.
* Track delivery milestones, risks, blockers, dependencies, and escalations while proactively communicating status to stakeholders.
* Take ownership of project outcomes by coordinating priorities, removing impediments, and ensuring teams remain aligned to business goals.

**Technical Delivery Focus*** Lead delivery for Node.js, React, and Next.js based applications, ensuring technical plans, release scope, and engineering execution are aligned.
* Coordinate with architects and senior engineers on technical dependencies, integration points, performance considerations, and production readiness.
* Ensure delivery planning accounts for API development, front\-end implementation, server\-side rendering requirements, testing, deployment, and release validation.
* Drive predictable execution across full\-stack JavaScript teams while maintaining visibility on quality, code readiness, defects, and release risks.

**Project \& Stakeholder Management*** Work closely with product owners, engineering managers, architects, QA leads, and business stakeholders to align priorities, commitments, and delivery plans.
* Translate business priorities into executable delivery plans with clear milestones, dependencies, risks, and ownership.
* Provide regular delivery updates through status reports, dashboards, reviews, and leadership communications.
* Identify and manage risks, issues, scope changes, and escalations in a timely and structured manner.

**Team Leadership*** Guide and coordinate multiple team members to ensure clarity of responsibilities, delivery focus, and collaboration across functions.
* Support team productivity by removing blockers, resolving dependencies, and enabling effective decision\-making.
* Promote ownership, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within the project team.
* Partner with functional leads to ensure resource allocation, capacity planning, and delivery commitments are realistic and achievable.

 **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS*** 10–15 years of overall experience in software delivery, project management, program coordination, or engineering delivery leadership.
* Must have led at least one project involving multiple resources across development, QA, product, and stakeholder teams.
* Proven experience taking ownership of one or more projects from planning through execution, release, and closure.

 **KEY SKILLS*** Delivery planning and execution for Node.js, React, and Next.js projects
* Project ownership and accountability
* Stakeholder communication and expectation management
* Risk, issue, dependency, and escalation management
* Agile ceremonies, sprint tracking, and release coordination
* Full\-stack JavaScript delivery awareness, including APIs, front\-end implementation, testing, deployments, and release readiness
* Team coordination, prioritization, and resource alignment
* Status reporting, governance, and delivery metrics

**SUCCESS MEASURES*** Projects are delivered with clear scope, timelines, ownership, and stakeholder visibility.
* Risks, blockers, and dependencies are identified early and managed proactively.
* Team members have clear priorities and accountability for committed outcomes.
* Stakeholders receive timely, transparent, and accurate delivery updates.
* Delivery processes continuously improve based on retrospectives, metrics, and feedback.
* Strong delivery experience with Node.js, React, and Next.js based applications, preferably using JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Good understanding of web application architecture, API integrations, front\-end delivery, back\-end services, CI/CD, testing cycles, and production release processes.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery practices, sprint execution, release planning, dependency tracking, and delivery governance.
* Experience working with cross\-functional and distributed teams in a product engineering or software services environment.

title: Lead/Senior Solution Architect - AI Modernisation
description:

We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We’re looking for a **Lead/Senior Solution Architect** to join our growing team in India and help design cutting\-edge solutions for global clients.


We are seeking an experienced Lead/Senior professional with deep specialization in AI technologies and Application Modernisation to lead the design and delivery of transformative AI solutions. This role combines technical expertise in AI architecture with practical experience in modernising legacy systems and evolving enterprise platforms.

* Design and develop AI\-driven solutions and agentic platforms that deliver measurable business value
* Lead application modernisation initiatives that incorporate AI technologies to enhance and transform existing systems
* Assess legacy systems and recommend modernisation strategies
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions
* Implement and optimize Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models for enterprise applications
* Conduct research to stay updated on the latest trends and advancements in AI technologies and modernisation patterns
* Design migration pathways from monolithic to microservices, cloud\-native, or AI\-enabled architectures
* Ensure seamless integration of AI solutions with existing systems and platforms
* Communicate effectively with clients and stakeholders to present solutions and gather feedback

* 14\+ years of general IT experience, including proven experience as a Solution Architect, particularly in AI technologies and application modernisation
* Hands\-on experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) models in production environments
* Demonstrated expertise in application modernisation, including legacy system assessment, refactoring strategies, and monolith\-to\-microservices transformation
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong research skills to stay abreast of the latest AI trends, modernisation patterns, and technologies
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Proficiency in English at an Upper\-Intermediate level (B2\) or higher

**Nice to have**

* Experience with other AI and machine learning frameworks and tools
* Previous experience in developing agentic platforms
* Familiarity with containerization, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP)

* Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware technologies

**We offer**

* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
